repairs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this Vallabhadeva feeding-house scene and all main people, faces, costumes, actions, food, hands, light and camera. Make ONLY two historical-detail corrections: (1) Remove all modern black round buttons from the two pale-yellow shirts and any green vest, replacing them with discreet cloth-tied or concealed overlap closures in matching woven cloth. (2) Reduce the imposing tiered stone temple in the distant centre background into a modest low separate stone shrine precinct with only a plain stone doorway and low weathered masonry visible behind the feeding courtyard, softened by trees. Do not invent a distinctive South Indian tower, present-day Kamakhya dome or Ahom temple tower. Keep the feeding shelter timber/thatch and distinct from the small shrine. Preserve everything else, realistic hands, the named ruler's exact face and plum/ivory clothes, serving women and food. No lettering or watermark.
